svg.title: Diagnostic suppression and severity policy
svg.desc: The tidy-specific level adjuster moves to sawDiagnostic(), which edits the assembled diagnostic. Retains clangd suppression, NOLINT, system-macro filtering and warnings-as-errors. The nonempty-check guard is preserved: without active checks, tidy suppression and promotion remain disabled. Suppression, NOLINT, system-macro policy and warnings-as-errors retain their previous guard. With no active tidy checks, compiler-warning suppression and promotion remain unchanged.
